traversal.note: Measured by UPA250AnimBuildLibrary::BuildTraversalMontage, in the clip's own space (cm: forward, right, up), soldier-sized. windows: where the root stands at the end of each warp window (root_cm) and, when the sample warped to a point on the obstacle, that point (point_cm). approach: [time_s, root forward cm]. blend_out_s: when the sample lets the clip be left for ordinary movement.

soldier.note: The period soldier (SK_AMERICAN_SOLDIER): the game's own skeleton, no retarget. A MotionBricks clip comes in on this rig: its importer (Plugins/MotionBricksTraversal, used in the evaluation host) converts the SOMA export onto the soldier's own skeleton.

uefn.note: The Game Animation Sample's UEFN mannequin (staged, git-ignored), through the retargeter the locomotion pipeline made.

gun_tools.note: What the gun crew hold while their clips play (display only; the rules of tools/anim/ue_review_render.py, which the user reviewed in the reels of 2026-11-16/17). Until 2026-11-18 the crew mimed every tool with a musket in hand. Places are in the cannon's mesh space (x toward the muzzle, cm), from tools/anim/gun_geometry.json: the bore line was measured from the mesh's vertices (the barrel is elevated 9.38 degrees; it is not the Muzzle socket's level line) and so was the vent. Holds: bore (the staff along his hands, put exactly on the bore line when his hands are on it, its head never past the muzzle face otherwise; head sponge or rammer into the bore), upright (standing on its foot through his right hand, its middle mid_cm above his feet), to_vent (the match end on the vent and the staff through his right hand; out of reach, his hand at its foot), in_hand (in his right hand pointing away from the muzzle until his hand is at the muzzle's mouth and the round goes in; until_s into the clip if it never gets there), planted (its foot in the ground at planted_cm, as gunners stuck the linstock; mid_cm above the ground). A man at his station puts his musket away. GAME INVENTION: the offsets and the planted place.
